request: 격전지 협동 용병 크기 변화·느린 공격 및 힐/방어 반응 개선
scope: Cooperative presentation and versioned cooperative combat clock only; no schema, authentication, economic settings, roster or source-art changes.
findings: Mixed-speed party on turn clock v2: defense first actions 20342/25472 ms, healer 28892 ms, owner 3 Cryvern 8942 ms.
Animations sharing an enemy registered that enemy as their owner; another card cancelled mercenary windups at time zero.
Shared hit/idle squash/stretch and sampling a live authored sprite as the base SD made apparent size unstable; stable source SD dimensions are now retained.
changes: New rooms snapshot turnClockVersion 3: a 190 ms shared action slot (570 ms across three squads), 470 ms deployment; repeated support effects add no global wait and mercenary skill groups get a nonzero slot.

Keep exact gauge selection, owner-linked mercenary credit, RNG and damage/healing calculations. Elapsed encounter time is shorter; more actions can fit before the existing time limit. CMS monster stats, mechanic windows and battle limit are unchanged.

Actor-specific playback queues; cooperative action ownership excludes victims; shared incoming hit/idle cannot replace the active pose. Old queued groups expire on payload recovery and wave transitions.
Latest authoritative cooperative fighter frame controls HP/shield during concurrent effects, so a late animation cannot undo healing, damage or death.
Fixed rest SD dimensions, deduplicated Cryvern setup and no cooperative mercenary idle/hit scaling. Generic mercenary effects no longer move another actor's root.
Existing rooms with clock 1 or 2 retain their clock on disconnect/mechanic rebuild. New timing applies to newly created rooms.
